errata.quote: reflect the preferred option selected during Section 9.2
errata.evidence: In Part 2, Section 8.2 is 'Agree on options to refine action plan' (p. 156), where the preferred option is chosen. Section 9.2 is 'Define stakeholder communication messages for each' implementation phase (p. 161), which comes later and selects no option.

narrative.text: Part 2, Section 8.4 says the preferred option was selected in Section 9.2. Options are agreed in Section 8.2; Section 9.2 is about stakeholder messages.

errata.quote: strategies and plans that are referenced in Annex C
errata.evidence: In Part 3, Annex B is 'Examples of eHealth strategies' (pp. 220-221, Part 3 pp. 35-36), the list of country visions, strategies and plans. Annex C is 'Definition of terms used in the Toolkit' (p. 222, Part 3 p. 37).

narrative.text: Part 3, Chapter 6 (Conclusion) points to Annex C for the countries' eHealth visions, strategies and plans. That list is Annex B; Annex C is the glossary.
